mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior month compresses discount rates for equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05) when FEDFUNDS declines, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 4.0%, it signals economic weakness that depresses near-term equity returns, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE exceeds 4.0%, the 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in employment (PAYEMS) and fall in consumer spending (RSAFS) indicates labor market overheating followed by demand contraction, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward returns are positive when PAYEMS rises and RSAFS falls, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During a supply shock regime marked by a sharp decline in industrial production, corporate earnings face headwinds, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods of INDPRO decline exceeding 2%, the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of cases, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising trend in consumer spending (RSAFS) signals strong economic activity that supports equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When RSAFS rises, the 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05), or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year CPI inflation exceeds 3.5%, it triggers expectations of tighter monetary policy, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.5%, the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A housing market slowdown, indicated by monthly housing starts below 1400.0 thousand units, signals weak consumer confidence and reduced economic activity, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When HOUST falls below 1400.0, the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of cases, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in total employment (PAYEMS) reflects a strong labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When PAYEMS rises, the 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05), or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
